summary: The board approved issuing non-convertible debentures up to INR 10,000 Crore on a private placement basis and noted the resignation of Mr. Gautam Doshi.
quote: approved the issuance of listed, rated, unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures ("NCDs"), on a private placement basis, in one or more tranches and/or series, for an aggregate amount not exceeding INR 10,000 Crore.
